messages:
anya: Heads up — after upgrading @redwood/inference-js to 2.2.0 our parcel/vite build for an edge-targeted widget jumped ~450KB and at runtime we see "initRuntime is not defined" in the edge log.

derek: ouch. Are you using default import anywhere? E.g. `import Redwood from '@redwood/inference-js'`?

anya: yes in a tiny helper lib. Swapping to named import didn't fully fix the size. Bundle analyzer points to `dist/cjs` being pulled in.

mila: can you paste package json from node_modules? Might be a sideEffects issue or exports mapping.

anya: snippet:
```
"main": "dist/cjs/index.js",
"module": "dist/esm/index.js",
"types": "dist/index.d.ts",
"sideEffects": false,
"exports": {
  ".": { "import": "./dist/esm/index.js", "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js" },
  "./boot": { "import": "./dist/esm/boot.js", "require": "./dist/cjs/boot.js" }
}
```

noah: `sideEffects:false` plus a `./boot` file that mutates globals = recipe for missing runtime code. Bundlers will drop boot.js unless it's explicitly listed in sideEffects array. Also if ESM entry re-exports a CJS-built default through a cjs interop shim, that shim prevents tree-shaking.

derek: short term hacks that worked for some teams: 1) pin to 2.1.x, 2) import from the explicit ESM path (`@redwood/inference-js/esm`), 3) add the boot file to your bundler keeplist (vite: optimizeDeps.include or rollup input).

mila: consumer-side fixes are brittle. We'll open an SDK issue. Maintainers should either remove `sideEffects:false` or add `./dist/esm/boot.js` to the allowlist. Better: make boot idempotent and explicit (export `initBoot()` so consumers call it).

pkg-bot: Created ISSUE-DEV-1123: "js sdk: sideEffects + cjs interop causing edge startup error and bundle bloat" assigned to eng-devex.

noah: note on typings — when rollup prunes files incorrectly downstream TS projects saw missing re-exports in d.ts due to files being elided. We should verify the published types reference the ESM paths and not rely on bundler rewriting.

anya: repro: https://codesandbox.io/s/rw-inference-boot-repro-xyz (tiny example). I'll pin to 2.1.x in prod for now.

derek: action items for SDK owners: (a) update package.json sideEffects to include boot, (b) publish a clean ESM entry without CJS re-export shim, (c) add integration tests for vite/esbuild/webpack + edge, (d) add note in upgrade guide about default vs named import and edge runtimes.

mila: also add a small example in the repo showing the recommended import patterns for Next/Vercel edge and for Vite-based bundles.

anya: thanks — saved our rollout. Will follow the issue for the fix. :thumbsup:
